ads.description: Find the best rate for your travel dates.
ads.headline: Hotel booking made easy
ads.label: Ad
ads.prompt: I am comparing a four-night business hotel in Gurugram with breakfast, Wi-Fi and flexible cancellation. Recommend three offers to shortlist and include the return, cancellation or warranty terms to verify before paying. Focus on options available in India. Keep the answer under 150 words; use Indian rupees where relevant.
